{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsorcart dumpster''' or '''repulsorlift dumpster''' was a mobile trash collection unit used by [[Janitor/Legends|sanitation workers]]. Pushed by the worker, the repulsorcart dumpster was used to store trash that was picked up from public locations, such as items picked up by a [[trash punch]]. Sanitation workers emptied the dumpster into a [[disintegrator]] at a [[City/Legends|city]] services center at the end of the worker's shift. [[Birrge]], a sanitation worker in [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], used a repulsorcart dumpster on a daily basis.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>
